sloka: ऋषिभित्राससंभ्रान्तैस्त्यज्यमानश्शिलोच्चयः - यद्वा -ऋषिभिः त्रास संभ्रांतैः त्यज्यमानः शिला उच्चयः ।सीदन् महति कांतारे सार्थ हीन इव अध्व गः ॥४-६७-४८॥
transliteration: ṛṣibhitrāsasaṁbhrāntaistyajyamānaśśiloccayaḥ - yadvā -ṛṣibhiḥ trāsa saṁbhrāṁtaiḥ tyajyamānaḥ śilā uccayaḥ ।sīdan mahati kāṁtāre sārtha hīna iva adhva gaḥ ॥4-67-48॥

translations.english: The serpents with their bodies half protruded out of the rocks and hissing looked like flags planted on the mountain.
